findings: entering_dart is an actual walk induction: if the first step enters the label it witnesses the conclusion, otherwise the suffix does.

first_self follows from mutual original-graph reachability and acyclicity. first_mem_support either reduces the original-source label to that source or finds an entering dart on the actual takeUntil prefix; the fixed-source filter forces its endpoint to be the canonical first vertex.

entry_label establishes the chain label of each actual visited-chain entry. Applying label to equal entry vertices proves injectivity, so image cardinality equals the actual chain count. pathEntries_mem separately places every entry on the path and in the actual important set.
minimum_takeUntil uses the previously reviewed minimum_prefix theorem with the original source unchanged and the exact take/drop decomposition.
scope: Actual important entries and exact prefix counts only. No source-rebased optimality, potential progress, multiplicity or cubic-size theorem is claimed.
